| description = These are standard warrior mobs found in Skyshrine. They have no special abilities and can wield weapons, making them great to charm. Like all mobs in Skyshrine, they have very high health regeneration.

'''Be warned:''' the cube who paths up the ramp leading to the maze can occasionally spawn as a ''supercube'' with like five times as much HP and dramatically higher resists. It will consider the same and have no visually differentiating features. Thankfully it does not summon and should be treated more like an undercon than anything.

'''''Supercube info:'''''
You'll know your cube is a supercube if it's immune to mezzes - [[Rapture]] included. It frequently hits for 199 and will take little to no damage, but it can still be rooted and charmed ([[Allure]] lands) if you're willing to take the risk.

Need confirmation if these cubes can drop all items currently listed on this page's loot table; personally I have never seen anything but assorted low tier items after hundreds of kills (e.g. [[Brightwood Spear]], [[Walrusbone Shield]] & [[Coldstone Wreath]]). ''- Decoyboy, 5/2/2025''
